🔥 Firebase Cross-Device Multiplayer Setup

Firebase Not Configured

For cross-device online multiplayer across separate laptops, Android phones & iPhones (up to 10 players per room), paste your Firebase Realtime Database configuration below. Once connected, your WhatsApp invitation links automatically include the connection key so invited friends join your Firebase room with a single tap!

Leave blank to auto-detect window.location.origin + window.location.pathname when hosted online.

Complete Step-by-Step Firebase Setup Guide:
  1. Go to https://console.firebase.google.com and click Create a project.
  2. In the left sidebar, open Build → Authentication → Get started, select the Sign-in method tab, enable Anonymous, and click Save.
  3. Open Build → Realtime Database → Create Database, choose a region, start in Locked or Test mode, and copy your database URL (https://YOUR-PROJECT-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com).
  4. Open Project Overview (⚙️) → Project settings → General → Your apps, click the Web icon (</>), register your app, and copy the firebaseConfig object into the box above (or paste it into DEFAULT_FIREBASE_CONFIG inside the HTML source code before deploying).
  5. Open Realtime Database → Rules and publish the production security rules below.
Firebase Realtime Database Security Rules (database.rules.json) 
{
  "rules": {
    "rooms": {
      "$roomCode": {
        ".read": "auth != null",
        ".write": "auth != null && (!data.exists() || data.child('participants').numChildren() <= 10 || data.child('participants').hasChild(auth.uid) || data.child('hostAuthUid').val() == auth.uid)",
        ".validate": "newData.hasChildren(['roomCode', 'hostUid', 'auctionStatus', 'settings'])",
        "participants": {
          "$participantId": {
            ".write": "auth != null && (!data.exists() ? data.parent().numChildren() < 10 : true)",
            ".validate": "newData.hasChildren(['uid', 'name', 'teamId'])"
          }
        },
        "liveLot": {
          ".write": "auth != null",
          ".validate": "newData.hasChildren(['playerSr', 'currentBidLakhs', 'deadlineTs']) && newData.child('currentBidLakhs').isNumber()"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
🌐 Public Deployment Guide (So WhatsApp Links Work on Any Phone):

Because this entire application is a self-contained index.html file, you can host it publicly for free in 60 seconds:

  • Option 1 — Netlify Drop (Fastest): Rename this file to index.html, open app.netlify.com/drop, and drag-and-drop the folder containing index.html. You get an instant HTTPS URL (https://your-site.netlify.app).
  • Option 2 — Firebase Hosting: Run npx firebase-tools init hosting & npx firebase-tools deploy.
  • Option 3 — Vercel / GitHub Pages: Push index.html to a GitHub repo and enable GitHub Pages or import into Vercel.
